svg.title: PodVigil safe recovery
svg.desc: Waiting is an observation of the existing job ledger and never triggers recovery. A terminal phase, a watchdog no longer heard, a waiting timeout or Ctrl+C ends waiting without changing the job. The separate recover command verifies ownership and keeps the original deadline. Unknown creation results are reconciled without another create. Unproven ownership never authorizes deletion. Compute cleanup is verified before restoring outputs, and incomplete backup retains storage.
svg.text: Recover an existing job without guessing ownership
